summary.text: Ron Schutz is the Republican nominee for Minnesota Attorney General. A Medina attorney, he is the former chairman of a national litigation firm and a former Army JAG Corps prosecutor, and is campaigning on prosecuting fraud, supporting law enforcement and keeping biological males from competing in girls' sports.

paragraphs.text: Former chairman of a 200-lawyer national litigation firm; began his career as a prosecutor in the U.S. Army JAG Corps.
Practices law through Schutz PLLC; lives in Medina.

sources.title: Attorney General 2026 Election Guide (candidate questionnaire responses, published as submitted)
